description: This file defines the implementation of the 'Caps' class and related functions for managing OpenGL texture and extension capabilities within the ANGLE project. It includes methods for querying supported formats, extension support, and hardware limits, as well as setting extension support flags based on texture capabilities.

classes.name: TextureCaps
classes.description: Represents the capabilities of a specific texture format, including support for texturing, filtering, and sample counts.

classes.name: TextureCapsMap
classes.description: A mapping from internal texture formats to their respective TextureCaps objects, managing insertion, retrieval, and initialization.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: Represents supported OpenGL extensions, with methods to retrieve extension strings and set support flags based on texture capabilities.

classes.name: Limitations
classes.description: Holds limitations and minimum capabilities for different OpenGL versions.

classes.name: TypePrecision
classes.description: Describes the precision and range of various data types used in shaders.

classes.name: Caps
classes.description: Encapsulates various hardware and driver limits and capabilities for OpenGL contexts.

methods.name: getMaxSamples
methods.description: Returns the maximum supported sample count for textures.

methods.name: getNearestSamples
methods.description: Returns the nearest supported sample count greater than or equal to the requested samples.

methods.name: GenerateMinimumTextureCaps
methods.description: Generates a TextureCaps object with minimum supported features for a given internal format, client version, and extensions.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a TextureCaps object into the TextureCapsMap for a specific internal format.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the TextureCapsMap to default values.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the TextureCaps for a given internal format or format ID.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the TextureCaps for a specific format ID.

methods.name: InitMinimumTextureCapsMap
methods.description: Initializes a TextureCapsMap with minimum capabilities for all formats based on client version and extensions.

methods.name: getStrings
methods.description: Returns a list of supported extension strings.

methods.name: setTextureExtensionSupport
methods.description: Sets extension support flags based on the provided texture capabilities.

methods.name: setIEEEFloat
methods.description: Sets the TypePrecision to IEEE float parameters.

methods.name: setTwosComplementInt
methods.description: Sets the TypePrecision to two's complement integer parameters.

methods.name: setSimulatedFloat
methods.description: Sets the TypePrecision to simulated float parameters.

methods.name: setSimulatedInt
methods.description: Sets the TypePrecision to simulated integer parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the range and precision of the TypePrecision.

methods.name: GenerateMinimumCaps
methods.description: Generates a Caps object with minimum supported capabilities for a given client version and extensions.
